第49届卡罗维发利国际电影节(2014)
　　纪录片 最佳纪录片（30分钟以上）(提名) 丽莎·韦伯
　　纪录片 最佳纪录片特别提名奖（30分钟以上） 丽莎·韦伯
introduction: A relationship in the summer of its 47th year, a man and a woman travel to North Cape. By car. Driving for the sake of driving, not to reach a destination. They listen to hits, the same CD over and over again. And are filmed by their granddaughter. Sausages brought from home and a Santa Claus village, Swedish landscapes, and Norwegian rain. An endless driving around in circles. The closer they get to reaching their destination, the less important it becomes. A film about the difficulties of a long marriage. And on top of that about the difference between a reindeer and an elk, between a man and a woman, between grandma and grandpa. And at the end, music and noodle soup.
